title: Yanomami wusinari insect beings and multitudinous dancing spirits
summary: Andrew Gallimore tells of Yanomami wusinari insect beings and multitudinous dancing spirits, about thousands of years ago to present at Amazon rainforest, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: were talking about um the Yanomami for example had these these beings which which they called the wusinari insect beings

plain: Andrew Gallimore, a neuroscientist who studies DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug, says on Jesse Michels' podcast that the Yanomami, a people of the Amazon rainforest, describe insect-like beings they call wusinari, along with crowds of dancing spirits. He brings this up because, in his view, beings like these resemble what people meet on DMT, which would hint at a real realm that many cultures have reached.
